name: warm-orange-intellectual-gentleman
image_vibe: Warm cinematic intellectual, bold orange-red contrast, polished editorial
image_purpose: Create a premium menswear lookbook portrait with a confident modern intellectual mood.

prompt.project_info: An ultra-realistic cinematic studio portrait of a stylish adult man in tailored menswear.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult man wearing thin round metal eyeglasses, a minimal navy blazer over a black crew-neck shirt, with natural hair strands, realistic skin texture, and a confident thoughtful expression.
prompt.composition_elements: Slightly low-angle portrait with subtle pose variations, warm orange-red gradient background, bold color contrast, and clean fashion-editorial framing.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft front key light with warm rim lighting sculpting the jawline and cheekbones, deep controlled shadows, and moody premium studio atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Premium DSLR look, 85mm lens aesthetic, shallow depth of field, sharp facial details, realistic hair and skin texture, ultra-high resolution, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-realistic cinematic studio portrait of an original adult man wearing thin round metal eyeglasses, a minimal navy blazer over a black crew-neck shirt. Shoot from a slightly low angle with confident thoughtful expression and subtle pose variations. Use a dramatic warm orange-red gradient background, bold color contrast, soft front key light, warm rim lighting sculpting the jawline and cheekbones, deep controlled shadows, natural skin texture, sharp realistic hair strands, premium DSLR 85mm shallow-depth look, modern intellectual fashion-editorial atmosphere, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, nudity, distorted glasses, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, oversaturated background, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, watermark, text, deformed

assets.name: source warm-orange menswear reference
assets.usage: Use only for menswear, glasses, low-angle framing, gradient, and lighting; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the original adult male, navy blazer, black shirt, round glasses, warm orange-red gradient, 85mm look, and intellectual mood. Identity and non-essential pose variations may be replaced.
